name: Deal Transaction Details 6
definition: Details of the triparty collateral transaction deal.

MinimumNoticePeriod.name: Minimum Notice Period
MinimumNoticePeriod.definition: Identifies the number of days in which the cash investor and dealer can agree to revisit the terms of an agreement.

ClosingDate.name: Closing Date
ClosingDate.definition: Closing date/time or maturity date/time of the transaction.

DealDetailsAmount.name: Deal Details Amount
DealDetailsAmount.definition: Specifies the details for the deal amounts.

PricingRateAndIndex.name: Pricing Rate And Index
PricingRateAndIndex.definition: Interest rate to be paid on the transaction amount as agreed between the counterparties and the tenor of the interest rate index.

OvernightFrequencyRateFixing.name: Overnight Frequency Rate Fixing
OvernightFrequencyRateFixing.definition: Indicates for a floating rate transaction if an overnight frequency  rate fixing should be applied.  If not present, a periodic fixing frequency will be applied (default is N).

Spread.name: Spread
Spread.definition: Margin allowed over or under a given rate.

DayCountBasis.name: Day Count Basis
DayCountBasis.definition: Specifies the computation method of (accrued) interest of the financial instrument.

Payment.name: Payment
Payment.definition: Specifies whether the instruction is free or against payment.

OptionType.name: Option Type
OptionType.definition: Specifies whether it is a Call option (right to purchase a specific underlying asset) or a Put option (right to sell a specific underlying asset).

TerminationOption.name: Termination Option
TerminationOption.definition: Indication whether the counterparties to the transaction have agreed to an evergreen or extendable repo.

OvernightFrequencyRateFixingGuideline.definition: If the indicator is not present then the default interpretation  is that the rate fixing frequency is periodic.

OvernightFrequencyRateFixingForFloatingO.definition: The Overnight Frequency Rate Fixing flag can be used only for floating rates.

OptionTypePresenceRule.definition: If OptionType is present then TerminationOption is not allowed.

TerminationOptionPresenceRule.definition: If TerminationOption is present then OptionType is not allowed.
